description_en: Queries the most recent 10 execution instances of a job
description_zh: 根据关键字过滤，返回任务执行的历史记录
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 get-job-instance-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 92583 --status 5 --start-timestamp 1684116000000 --end-timestamp 1684202400000 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJobInstanceList

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job instance. Valid values:

1: The job instance is pending. 3: The job instance is running. 4: The job instance is run. 5: The job instance fails. 9: The request for running the job instance is rejected. To specify this parameter, you must declare the following enumeration class: com.alibaba.schedulerx.common.domain.InstanceStatus
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。包含以下几种状态：

1：等待
3：运行中
4：成功
5：失败
9：拒绝
对应枚举类： com.alibaba.schedulerx.common.domain.InstanceStatus
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_zh: 分页获取数据，分页号，默认是1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页获取数据，分页大小，默认是10
parameters.name: page_size
